```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# import data into RStudio

screen_time <- read.csv("C:/Users/frant/OneDrive/Documents/GitHub/Fall 26 Stat 112/ds112-portfolio-chrisfrantz10/pvj/PVJ spreadsheet Oct 18 - 24 - Sheet1.csv")
```

Play around with some viz

```{r}
screen_time |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Category, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
screen_time |>
  ggplot(aes(y = Time..Minutes., fill = Category)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
